program: dup dup [ 1 add ] map [ [ lt? ] swap cons ] map swap [ filter ] fold 0 [ swap drop ] fold [ sub ] swap cons map
notes: Minimum by folding filter over the (x+1 lt?) predicates (copies of the smallest remain), read off with 0 [ swap drop ] fold, then subtracted from every value by a bound map. Replaces #155's 7-atom ifte combine; empty input gives nil.

program: dup [ 0 swap sub ] map cat [ 0 lt? false eq? ] filter dup [ 1 add ] map [ [ lt? ] swap cons ] map swap [ filter ] fold uncons swap drop
notes: The values joined with their negations, the non-negative half (the magnitudes), then the minimum by folding filter over (m+1 lt?) predicates and taking the head. Replaces #155's 7-atom ifte min fold.

program: dup 0 [ add ] fold swap dup uncons drop [ quote ] map [ [ lt? ] cat ] map [ [ false eq? ] cat ] map [ quote [ filter ] cat ] map [ [ dup ] swap cat ] map [ [ uncons ] swap cat ] map [ [ cons ] quote cat ] map [ [ dip ] cat ] map swap quote [ i cons ] fold [ uncons swap drop ] map 0 [ add ] fold swap sub
notes: Sum of prefix maxima minus the sum. Seeded with xs, step closures (uncons dup (y lt? false eq?) filter (cons) dip) from the tail keep every stage of filtering xs by 'at least y'; each stage's head is that prefix's maximum (xs itself supplies the first). Empty input refuses at uncons, as #155's witness does.

program: [ dup mul ] map [ [ cons ] swap cons ] map [ [ swap cons ] cat ] map [ nil quote ] i [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold dup uncons drop [ quote ] map [ [ add quote ] cat ] map [ [ cat ] cat ] map swap uncons [ drop ] dip [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold nil [ cons ] fold
notes: Squares, dealt into two reversed slots by a slot-swap fold of (q cons swap cons) closures, zipped as a queue by (b add quote cat) closures to give the pair sums, then reversed into order. Replaces #155's 6-atom deal and zip bodies.

program: [ quote dup cat ] map [ [ lt? ] quote cat ] map [ [ swap cons ] cat ] map [ [ cons ] quote cat ] map [ [ dip over ] cat ] map [ [ over false ] cat ] map [ [ quote ] cat ] map [ [ eq? ] quote cat ] map [ [ cat cat ] cat ] map [ [ filter ] cat ] map [ [ filter ] quote cat ] map nil [ i dip cat ] fold
notes: Insertion sort: each x becomes the closure (x x (lt?) swap cons (cons) dip over over false quote (eq?) cat cat filter (filter)), built two tokens per map, which on the sorted S leaves T P U with T = x.S, P = (x lt?), U = T's values >= x; the fold body `i dip cat` prepends filter(T, P). 91 ops against #155's 36-atom body.
